description.default: Model-driven apps in which the Replay button is shown, as a comma-separated list of app unique names, for example msdyn_CustomerServiceWorkspace,Customerservicehub. Use * for all apps. The default none hides Replay everywhere until an administrator enables it.

label.description: Model-driven apps in which the Replay button is shown, as a comma-separated list of app unique names, for example msdyn_CustomerServiceWorkspace,Customerservicehub. Use * for all apps. The default none hides Replay everywhere until an administrator enables it.

Modelgestuurde apps waarin de knop Replay wordt getoond, als kommagescheiden lijst van unieke app-namen, bijvoorbeeld msdyn_CustomerServiceWorkspace,Customerservicehub. Gebruik * voor alle apps. De standaardwaarde none verbergt Replay overal totdat een beheerder het inschakelt.
